children: SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion as revenue in the third quarter more than doubled over the same period last year.

Growth at the world's largest rocket company and satellite-internet provider was supercharged by its AI segment, though it also saw gains in its space and connectivity businesses. SpaceX shares rose nearly 3% immediately following the report; they were recently up 1.5%..
